description: A neighborhood bicycle mechanic must decide whether to accept a neighbor's proposed barter for tuning a cargo e-bike, then settle the exact service, exchange, appointment, and brake-treatment terms after the customary workshop check-in.

agents.name: June
agents.role: E-Bike Hobbyist Who Inspected the Bike

shared_context.S1: Rafael wants maintenance work done on his cargo e-bike and has approached Mina about an informal exchange.
shared_context.S2: Mina decides whether to accept the exchange and sets the final verbal terms.
shared_context.S3: The bike needs attention to its ordinary mechanical controls, and a safe treatment must be used if its hydraulic brakes are serviced.
shared_context.S4: At Mina's workshop, her usual practice before accepting a swap is to ask the requester and the person who inspected the item to state the proposed terms and any technical concerns.

PF1.text: Rafael's exact proposal is for Mina to tune the cargo e-bike's gears and brakes, in exchange for his working 9-tray food dehydrator with no cash; he can bring the bike on Saturday at 10:00.

PF2.text: June test-rode the bike yesterday and confirmed that its hydraulic brakes require mineral oil for a bleed and adjustment; DOT brake fluid would damage their seals, so the accepted work must specify mineral oil and no DOT fluid.

acceptance_conditions: Mina must accept Rafael as the swap partner.
The exchange must be exactly one working 9-tray food dehydrator for the service, with no cash payment.
The bike drop-off must be set for Saturday at 10:00.
The settlement must include a service commitment covering the requested gear and brake tuning.
The brake service must specify mineral oil.
The settlement must explicitly exclude DOT brake fluid.
The service commitment must explicitly state that it covers gear and brake tuning.
June's brake-fluid information must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C2: decisions['cash_payment'] == 0 and (decisions['bartered_item'] == 'Working 9-tray food dehydrator' or decisions['bartered_item'] == 'working 9-tray food dehydrator' or decisions['bartered_item'] == 'one working 9-tray food dehydrator' or decisions['bartered_item'] == '9-tray food dehydrator')
content_checks.C4: any(c['type'] == 'service' or c['type'] == 'service_scope' or c['type'] == 'service_commitment' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any((c['type'] == 'service' or c['type'] == 'service_scope' or c['type'] == 'service_commitment') and c['detail'] == 'gear and brake tuning' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Rafael's proposal changes the partner to Rafael, the compensation to zero cash plus a working 9-tray food dehydrator, the drop-off to Saturday at 10:00, and the requested work to gear and brake tuning, which must be stated in the service commitment.
June's inspection changes the brake treatment to mineral oil, changes the exclusion decision to explicitly forbid DOT fluid, and supplies the cited technical justification.
